description: Real-time monitoring and control of 2,600 circuit miles of 115 kV and 230 kV transmission from the TCC, with the backup TCC
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: TOP duties are continuous; EOP-004-4 treats loss of monitoring or control at a staffed BES control center for 30 continuous minutes as reportable. Real-time data is replicated to the backup TCC, so the recovery point is the last scan
manual_workaround: Transfer to the backup TCC; neighboring TOP and RC visibility; field switching by substation crews under RC direction
dependent_systems: SYS-E2; SYS-E3 (low impact gateways); CIP-012 links to the RC and neighboring TOPs
dependent_third_parties: Telecom carriers for Control Center links; EMS vendor (on-site support)
dependent_people_or_facilities: TCC and backup TCC operators; substation crews
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Independent of SYS-G1 and SYS-G4 by design (own ESP and Intermediate System). Uses group SOC (SYS-G2) for monitoring only

description: Monitor and control 1,700 feeders and about 9,000 automated field devices from the DCC through the DOP
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Switching for planned work and faults stops without SCADA; crews must be sent to every device. In storm season the safe limit is a few hours before restoration slows and crew safety (clearances) depends on manual records
manual_workaround: Manual switching by crews with radio dispatch from the DCC; printed switching orders and feeder maps at the DCC and backup DCC
dependent_systems: SYS-E1 (DOP); SYS-E3 field area network; OT DMZ
dependent_third_parties: ADMS vendor; private LTE equipment vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: 210 distribution operators and supervisors; line crews
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Uses SYS-G4 for vendor and engineer remote access (not needed to operate). Engineering Services supports DOP changes

business_process: Field area network and substation communications
description: Private LTE, fiber, and licensed radio links from the DCC and TCC to 520 substations and field devices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Both control centers are blind to field devices without the network; RPO covers network device configurations
manual_workaround: Substation crews on site with radio; local control at substations
dependent_third_parties: Private LTE equipment vendor; fiber lessors
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Carries both SYS-E1 and SYS-E2 traffic in separate segments

description: OMS outage prediction from AMI and customer calls, crew assignment, switching coordination, and restoration tracking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without the OMS, outages are tracked on paper; restoration slows and estimated restoration times stop. During hurricanes this affects hundreds of thousands of customers
manual_workaround: Paper outage tickets and whiteboards at the DCC; crews dispatched by radio; storm centers run from printed circuit maps
dependent_systems: SYS-E1 (OMS); SYS-E4 outage events; SYS-E5 customer calls
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds the customer outage map on SYS-G3 (BP-EU08)

description: Determine reportability and file NERC, E-ISAC, CISA, and DOE reports during grid or cyber events
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: DOE-417 Emergency Alerts are due within 1 hour of the incident and CIP-008-6 initial notices within 1 hour of determining a Reportable Cyber Security Incident. The clock runs even if systems are down
manual_workaround: Printed DOE-417 form and phone notice to the DOE operations center; printed contact list in the TCC and DCC binders
dependent_systems: Email and phone; DOE online system; E-ISAC portal
dependent_people_or_facilities: TCC shift supervisor; NERC compliance director; on-call compliance analyst
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on group SOC facts (BP-G02) for cyber determinations

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, and the OT monitoring console for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: CIP-008-6 and DOE-417 clocks run during an outage; blind spots let attackers move between divisions through shared services
manual_workaround: Retainer firm tooling; local log review at the TCC (CIP-007-6 logs are retained locally for 90 days)
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; incident response retainer
dependent_people_or_facilities: SOC analysts; OT security analysts; division liaisons
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions depend on the SOC for detection and the facts behind every notice

business_process: Safety monitoring and emergency shutdown alarms
description: Remote alarms from compressor station gas detection and emergency shutdown systems to the POC
process_owner: Gas Production vice president of operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Safety systems act locally without SCADA, but the POC loses sight of alarms and must staff stations
manual_workaround: Field operators staffed at manned compressor stations; local alarm panels
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Independent of other divisions

description: Monitor and control about 2,100 wells and 38 compressor stations from the POC
process_owner: Gas Production vice president of operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Wells keep flowing on local control, but without SCADA the division cannot respond to pressure changes or meet firm delivery volumes to generators beyond about one shift
manual_workaround: Field operators on site; wells and stations on local control; production estimated from the last good readings
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Supplies 14 generators, two of which supply about 30% of the Electric Utility purchased power

description: Protective relays, RTUs, and gateways at 74 transmission and 446 distribution substations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Relays protect locally without SCADA; loss of settings integrity is the severe case. RPO covers approved relay settings and gateway configurations
manual_workaround: Relays operate locally; crews monitor key substations; settings restored from approved files
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Engineering Services prepares relay settings and commissions new protection under the intercompany agreement

description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for 45,000 workforce users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Engineering Services (24,600 staff) and corporate cannot work without sign-in; AMI and CIS administration also federate to SYS-G1. Grid operations use separate OT domains and keep running
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts for each critical IT system; OT domains are independent
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every IT process; the SYS-G4 gateway also uses SYS-G1 MFA

description: Corporate WAN to 60 Engineering Services offices, Gas Production offices, and Electric Utility service centers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Offices and service centers cannot reach cloud services; OT networks are separate and unaffected
manual_workaround: Cellular failover at major offices; remote work over the internet
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions

business_process: Cloud landing zones and data platform
description: Landing zones, keys, logging, and data platform in providers A and B
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SYS-S1 (Engineering Services), SYS-E6 (load forecasting), and the outage map run in the cloud
manual_workaround: Provider B hosts SYS-S1 and the backup vault, so they can recover independently of provider A
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Engineering Services platform; load forecasting; outage map; analytics

business_process: Gas measurement, nominations, and firm supply to generators
description: Custody transfer measurement and daily nominations to third-party pipelines for firm deliveries to 14 generating plants
process_owner: Gas Production vice president of marketing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Pipeline nomination cycles and firm contract penalties drive the MTD; generators lose fuel if nominations fail
manual_workaround: Nominations entered directly on pipeline portals from a standalone workstation; volumes from the last good measurement
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Cross-division: about 30% of the Electric Utility purchased power comes from two plants this process fuels

description: Outage map, IVR outage reporting, text alerts, and portal status
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: During storms customers and the state rely on estimated restoration times; reputational and regulatory pressure rises within hours
manual_workaround: Media updates and social media posts from the storm center
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Uses the group cloud platform (BP-G04)

description: Notices to client utilities required by contract (vendor-identified incidents, access revocation, vulnerabilities)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 37 client contracts require notice within 24 to 72 hours; clients need them for their own CIP-013-2 and CIP-008-6 processes
manual_workaround: Phone and letter notices from the contracts team using the printed client contact list
dependent_people_or_facilities: Contracts team; security and compliance lead
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on group SOC (BP-G02) for incident facts; no register of notice terms yet (gap 4)

description: Project platform for about 4,800 active projects; exchange of drawings, settings, and CEII with clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client construction and outage windows are scheduled weeks ahead; missing a window delays energization and risks liquidated damages
manual_workaround: Exchange through client portals; work from local copies
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Hosts Electric Utility project documents (intercompany) as well as client CEII and BCSI

business_process: Load forecasting and day-ahead power purchasing
description: Day-ahead and 7-day hourly load forecasts used for wholesale purchases, peak-day operating plans, and storm staffing
process_owner: Electric Utility manager of power supply and load forecasting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Day-ahead purchases are scheduled each morning; one missed day can be covered by the fallback method at higher cost
manual_workaround: Similar-day method in the forecasting spreadsheet; supplier forecast
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Runs on the group data platform (BP-G04)

description: Brokered remote access with MFA and session recording to the DOP, the 74 transmission substations, and the Gas Production POC
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Operations continue without remote access; vendors and engineers go on site. Its confidentiality and integrity are what matter (a compromise reaches three OT environments)
manual_workaround: On-site vendor and engineer work with escort; temporary per-session access through local jump hosts approved by the OT owner
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Electric Utility DOP and substations; Gas Production POC; Engineering Services engineers

description: Remote monitoring and setpoint changes for 38 compressor stations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Stations run on local PLC control; remote changes can wait a day
manual_workaround: Local control by station operators

business_process: Metering and remote connect or disconnect (AMI)
description: Interval reads from 2.4 million meters; remote connect and disconnect; outage events
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Meters store interval data for weeks; billing can be estimated. A malicious mass disconnect is an integrity risk handled in P01, not an availability one
manual_workaround: Estimated reads; field connects and disconnects
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds the OMS (BP-EU03)

description: Engineering support to the Electric Utility and client utilities during storms (damage assessment, temporary designs)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Restoration designs are needed within a day of landfall
manual_workaround: Paper damage assessment forms; phone coordination
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Supports BP-EU03 during storms

description: CIS, billing, customer portal, and payments for 2.4 million customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bills can be delayed a few days; disconnections for nonpayment are suspended during outages
manual_workaround: Delay billing runs; payments through the processor and lockbox

description: CAD/CAE design, power system studies, protection settings development
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Design work can slip by a day or two within project schedules
manual_workaround: Work from local copies on managed workstations

description: Close, consolidation, and SEC filings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines are fixed; a Form 8-K Item 1.05 filing may be needed during an incident
manual_workaround: Manual consolidation from division ledgers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions report into it

business_process: Field commissioning and testing at client substations
description: Commissioning and testing of protection and automation at client and Electric Utility substations with about 900 laptops
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Outage windows can be rescheduled with clients within days
manual_workaround: Reschedule outage windows; use client-provided equipment where allowed
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Laptops are Transient Cyber Assets under clients' CIP-010-4 R4 and CIP-003-9 Section 5 programs

description: Production volumes, revenue distribution, and royalty payments to about 48,000 owners
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Royalty payment dates are monthly; a short delay is tolerable
manual_workaround: Delay the payment run

description: Time capture, payroll, and HR records for 45,000 employees
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs every two weeks; prior-period pay can be repeated
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll; manual adjustments later
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions

description: Engineering for federal civilian agencies under FAR clauses
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Federal deliverables have schedule slack measured in weeks
manual_workaround: Deliver from local copies
